$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFFC (AIP France, chart dated 2022-08-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Mantes - Chérence

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for gliders and service ACFT.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Take-off RWY 04: after TKOF route alteration of 20° right to avoid trees in the funnel.
Overflight of surrounding towns at low altitude is prohibited to tug ACFT.
Aerobatics (NR 6205): 1500 m long axis centered on ARP and orientated RWY 04/22 or 12/30.
Activity reserved for gliders of the AAVO and according to protocol.
Ceiling limited to 3500 ft AMSL if LF-R 3104V not activated.
Users' information on MANTES A/A FREQ.
Gliders winching on AD (NR 895) SFC- 2000 ft AMSL.
Winch activity indicated by flashing lights and radio message on A/A frequency.
Activity reserved for pilots authorized by CAA, contact: AAVO.
